"""Regression test for frac == 0.5 being non-degenerate.

The rules documentation says a null is degenerate only when it keeps *less than* half of the
aircraft-seconds. So frac == 0.5 must still count as a real null.
"""

from jf import rules


def test_frac_half_is_not_degenerate_and_counts_in_rules():
    cands = [(100.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)]
    nulls = [dict(kind="shift", verdict="nothing", best=20.0, frac=0.5)]

    out = rules.evaluate(cands, nulls, residual=10.0, support=[50.0, 40.0, 30.0])

    # frac == 0.5 must be treated as a live null, not a degenerate one.
    assert out["nulls_used"] == 1
    assert out["nulls_degenerate"] == 0
    assert out["null_best"] == 20.0
    assert out["conditions"]["a"] is True
    assert out["conditions"]["b"] is True
    assert out["conditions"]["c"] is True
